title: The quiet of Gros Morne
subtitle: Coastal villages, forest boardwalks and misty mountain trails, followed by a boat between the cliffs of Western Brook Pond.
location: Gros Morne National Park, Newfoundland & Labrador

cover.alt: Blue water between steep green and grey cliffs at Western Brook Pond beneath a bright sky.
cover.caption: Blue water between steep green and grey cliffs at Western Brook Pond beneath a bright sky.

chapters.title: Rocky Harbour and Lobster Cove Head
paragraphs: The coast begins with village streets, small buildings and blue water. At Lobster Cove Head, the lighthouse stands above the rocky shore.

chapters.title: The walk to Bakers Brook Falls
paragraphs: Boardwalks cross open ground before the trail reaches trees and running water. Small plants and bare trunks add detail along the way to the falls.

chapters.title: Fog on the high ground
paragraphs: Low cloud closes around the stony trail and low vegetation. Between the misty views are a café stop, a lookout over the forest and a wet road.

chapters.title: On the Gros Morne Mountain trail
paragraphs: The trail passes mossy trees, a metal bridge and streams below steep mountains. Above the forest are ponds, open meadows and low cloud, with fungi and flowers beside the return path.

chapters.title: Between the cliffs of Western Brook Pond
paragraphs: The approach crosses open ground below flat-topped cliffs. On the water, the boat passes waterfalls, rock faces and narrow views into the valley; the return walk ends with a kite and a lakeside rest.
